skills.name: Equivalent Fractions & LCD
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions to equivalent fractions with unlike denominators.

skills.name: Mixed & Whole Number Arithmetic
skills.definition: Separating and subtracting whole numbers and fractional parts in expressions containing mixed or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing in Subtraction
skills.definition: Regrouping or borrowing from a whole number unit to subtract a larger fraction from a smaller one.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing the numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions that already share a common denominator.
